title: A focus point can carry a note, typed or handwritten, and handwriting produces text with no model and no network

goals.description: note-editor with two tabs — Ketik and Tulis tangan — both writing the same content field
The handwriting tab is a plain <textarea> styled as ruled paper: ≥20px, line-height ≈2.4, spellCheck={false}, ~16px clear padding, no contenteditable, no rich-text library
Layout: the note sheet has its own stacking context and an opaque background; the Konva Stage beneath is pointer-events:none while it is open
writing-check — a one-time practice box per device; result in meta.handwriting (os / unavailable); per-platform enable instructions
Autosave debounced 800 ms, coalesced into one outbox op; input_mode records keyboard / stylus_os
Run the device test (v2 §3.4) on the pilot's real tablets, in Indonesian; record the result in validate.json
I27 as a named Playwright story test — the invariant task 000 deferred here
